name: code-word-frequency
prompt: Write a single self-contained Python function `top_n_words(text, n)` that returns the n most frequent words in `text` as a list of (word, count) tuples, ordered by count descending and then alphabetically for ties. Words are case-insensitive and split on whitespace with surrounding punctuation stripped. Use only the standard library. Put it in one complete ```python code block.
code_test:
res = top_n_words('The cat sat. The CAT ran; the dog sat!', 2)
assert res == [('the', 3), ('cat', 2)], res
res2 = top_n_words('a a b b c', 3)
assert res2 == [('a', 2), ('b', 2), ('c', 1)], res2
print('ok')
